Read out of saint.gr's line for 20 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Ζακχαίος ο Απόστολος», with the rank words left off; the day's line spells him Ζακχαίος and the page's couplet Ζακχαῖε, and the accented form of the nominative is stored here as the couplet has it.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 20 aprilie — «Sfântul Apostol Zaheu»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 20ής Απριλίου — «Άγιος Ζακχαίος ο Απόστολος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It is the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him. The page refers the reader to Luke 19:1-10 for the whole story, calls him the well-known chief publican of Jericho who climbed the sycamore because his height did not favour him, and adds, with «Λέγεται» — it is said — that after the Ascension of the Lord he followed the apostle Peter, by whom he was afterwards ordained bishop of Caesarea. It gives no year, so no `dates` were taken, and it prints no hymn. The page's couplet turns the Gospel's word round: not come down, but come up, Christ says to thee, Zacchaeus, calling thee to the vault of heaven.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).
